title: xcodebuild.nvim belongs on your radar
description:
This repo should be on your radar: wojciech-kulik/xcodebuild.nvim. Neovim plugin to Build, Debug, and Test applications created for Apple devices (iOS, macOS, watchOS, etc.). It has about 1,327 GitHub stars, and it is active enough to deserve a closer look. Save this for your next build, and follow for more useful developer tools.

https://github.com/wojciech-kulik/xcodebuild.nvim

#GitHub #OpenSource #Developer #Programming #Shorts
